summary: Backend-only retest of Point 44 (deferred parking coupon) after iter-75 moved the coupon hook into the shared choke points. New suite /app/backend/tests/test_iteration75_point44_paths.py (16 tests) + reran iter-74 suite (9) + iter-73 admin-gate regression (35). Result: 59 passed / 1 failed. Verified issuing on: _reprocess_single_bill Fundle-approve, queued /api/bills/{id}/reprocess (wait=false, in-process AND live through uvicorn against real Fundle → bill approved + exactly 1 PARK-XXXX coupon), force-credit-on-Fundle-reject fallback, WhatsApp process_bill_image auto_approved, WhatsApp force-credit fallback, consumer-app process_bill_ocr status='approved'. Verified NO coupon on: reprocess kept_pending, WhatsApp pending_review (settings off), consumer-app pending_review, reject via /process. Idempotency holds under 6 concurrent helper calls (exactly 1 issuance). Dead except block and the duplicate hook in _do_reprocess_bill_sync are confirmed removed (static assertions). ONE remaining gap: the explicit force_credit=True branch of _reprocess_single_bill (admin POST /api/admin/bills/{id}/force-credit and both edit-brand auto-force-credit calls) approves the bill and credits points but never calls the hook.

critical.issue: The explicit force_credit branch sets status='approved', $inc's user points and returns action='approved' WITHOUT calling _maybe_issue_pending_parking_coupon (unlike the Fundle-approve branch at ~4207 and the fundle-reject fallback at ~4264). A parking-QR user whose first bill is approved via admin Force-Credit or via edit-brand auto-force-credit gets points but no parking coupon; parking_coupon_pending stays true until the 60-day window silently clears it. Reproduced: test_reprocess_explicit_force_credit_issues_coupon (0 coupons). Fix: add the same try/except hook after the users $inc (and also add the missing _sync_staff_incentive_for_bill call there — that branch skips staff sync too, unlike the other two approve branches).

minor.issue: Legacy reprocess implementation also sets status='approved' + credits points with no parking-coupon hook and no staff-incentive sync. Not used by the admin UI, but it is still a registered route — either delete it or add the hook.

Still open from iter-74: datetime.fromisoformat() on a naive stored expiry raises TypeError inside the inner try → swallowed → coupon issued even though the window expired. Normalise to tz-aware before comparing.

action_items: Add _maybe_issue_pending_parking_coupon (+ _sync_staff_incentive_for_bill) to the explicit force_credit=True approve branch in _reprocess_single_bill (server.py ~4136, right after the users balance $inc).
Decide on reprocess-legacy: delete the route or add the same hook.
Optional: make the pending-expiry comparison tz-safe in _maybe_issue_pending_parking_coupon.
critical_code_review_comments: The choke point is now correct for the Fundle paths, but _reprocess_single_bill still has THREE independent 'approve' exits (force_credit, fundle-success, fundle-reject-fallback) each duplicating bill update + points $inc + staff sync + coupon hook. Extract one _finalise_bill_approval(bill_id, user, phone, points, extra_fields) helper — this is exactly the fragmentation that caused iter-74's miss and it just recurred in the force_credit branch.

routes/consumer.py's runtime `from server import _maybe_issue_pending_parking_coupon` works but is a code smell; move Point 44 logic into a routes/parking.py module importable by both server.py and routes/consumer.py.
server.py is 9581 lines — still needs splitting.

rca_of_the_issue: Iter-75 added the hook to the two Fundle-driven approve exits of _reprocess_single_bill but the function has a third earlier approve exit (the force_credit=True short-circuit at line ~4110 that skips Fundle entirely) which was left untouched; that exit is what POST /admin/bills/{id}/force-credit and the edit-brand auto-force-credit background tasks use, so those approvals still credit points without issuing the deferred coupon.
